citations.title: NASA’s Webb Reveals an Exoplanet Atmosphere as Never Seen Before
Early Release Science of the exoplanet WASP-39b with JWST NIRISS
authors: Adina D. Feinstein and the JWST Transiting Exoplanet Community Early Release Science Team

claims.statement: Webb observations are reported to support atmospheric water, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, sodium, potassium and sulfur dioxide. Abundances and vertical or geographic distributions are not imported here.

Published NIRISS/SOSS transmission-depth fits and a published comparison model are imported from the authors’ pinned public data repository. This is a wavelength-dependent transit signal, not reflected visible colour.
claims.sourceLocator: Repository data/ts/CMADF-WASP_39b_NIRISS_transmission_spectrum_R300.csv and data/Main_Models/model_reference.txt; order 1 and quality-zero selection

observations.calibration: Published CMADF/nirHiss transit fits; instrument calibration is not rerun. Wavelength half-width and reported errors retained.
observations.responseFunction: Published bin centres and half widths; detailed instrument throughput not ingested.
observations.limitations: Transmission depths constrain limb opacity through a retrieval model. They do not measure human-visible reflected colour, surface geography or a spatial abundance map.

comparison.method: Linear interpolation at published band centres; spectral response not convolved. Diagnostic residuals assume independent published errors; no fit probability is claimed.

citations.title: The Deep Blue Color of HD189733b: Albedo Measurements with Hubble Space Telescope/Space Telescope Imaging Spectrograph at Visible Wavelengths

claims.statement: Secondary-eclipse STIS photometry constrains geometric albedo in two broad bands. The preferred fit supports a blue disc-integrated visible appearance, with no spatial cloud map.
claims.sourceLocator: Abstract, 290–450 nm and 450–570 nm geometric-albedo constraints

uncertainty.reportedLevel: 1 sigma as stated in the paper; no probability conversion
1 sigma as stated in the paper; no probability conversion

observations.calibration: Publication geometric-albedo estimates; raw detector calibration and bandpass response are not reprocessed.
observations.limitations: One-sigma constraints, not hard physical exclusions. Wavelengths outside these bands and spectral interpolation remain unconstrained. Geometric albedo is not a material reflectance spectrum.
